$note: Descriptive specs only -- actual SVG/illustration assets are a Phase 4 task, not produced here. Each entry documents intent so Phase 4 illustration work has a clear brief instead of starting from a blank page.

motifs.description: A hand-painted rectangular signboard frame with a slightly uneven, brush-stroke border -- for wrapping section headers or card titles in the signboard aesthetic (see सफ़र-ए-UP / डीलक्स सैलून references).
A simple line/filled icon of a small steel katori bowl, viewed from a 3/4 angle -- the app's core household-unit symbol.
motifs.usage: Household-unit calibration UI, katori-based quantity pickers

motifs.description: A round steel thali plate with 2-3 small katori compartments visible -- represents 'today's full meal' at a glance.
A small curved glass tumbler with visible chai-colored liquid and a bit of steam -- for beverage logging.
motifs.usage: Beverage logging entry points, chai/coffee builder screens

motifs.description: A round tin container with a paper label band, echoing the Gopal Ghee Bhandar signboard -- for oil/ghee quantity in a recipe.
motifs.usage: oil_ghee field UI in the (future) recipe builder screens

motifs.description: A wooden vegetable-market crate, slightly overflowing -- for ingredient browsing/search.
motifs.usage: Ingredient search/browse empty states and section headers
